WITH
cash_flow AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
holding_gain AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(current_value - cost) AS holding_gain
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
    WHERE cost IS NOT NULL
      AND current_value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
rebalance AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(amount) AS total_rebalance_amount
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
goal_shortfall AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           AVG(shortfall) AS avg_goal_shortfall
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
)
SELECT p.investor_id,
       (cf.net_cash_flow + hg.holding_gain + rb.total_rebalance_amount - gs.avg_goal_shortfall) AS composite_score
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 AS p
INNER JOIN cash_flow cf          ON p.investor_id = cf.investor_id
INNER JOIN holding_gain hg       ON p.investor_id = hg.investor_id
INNER JOIN rebalance rb          ON p.investor_id = rb.investor_id
INNER JOIN goal_shortfall gs     ON p.investor_id = gs.investor_id
